audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart marks every one of the seven rows 'Skill', and content win[0..6] is also all 'Skill', which contradicts the packet chart (Ryze / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill / Ryze / Ryze) and contradicts the prose whys, which explicitly describe Ryze owning levels 1-3 and out-scaling after Tear.
audit.why: Ryze's Overload is a 1000-range 5s-cooldown nuke against Gangplank's 625-range Parrrley, so early rows belong to Ryze; Gangplank's second Q/E points and Sheen give him the mid rows; a Tear-stacked Ryze takes the item rows.
audit.corrected: Set both charts to Ryze / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill / Ryze / Ryze with matching ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Gangplank's real windows are levels 4-5 (second Q/E points, chained keg) and Sheen/Trinity Force; Ryze's are levels 1-3 poke and 2+ items with Tear stacks. Four spike entries present, no structural gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Rune Prison calls it a 'point-blank root' that 'sets up his combo'. Rune Prison is 615 range and, per Riot's own text, only ROOTS if Flux (Spell Flux, E) is already on the target — otherwise it damages and slows. The order is reversed and the range is wrong. Nothing anywhere names Overload, Spell Flux or Realm Warp.
audit.why: Riot text, Rune Prison (W): 'traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Cooldown 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, range 615. Spell Flux (E) is the setup, cooldown 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5. Remove Scurvy (W, 22/20/18/16/14) cures crowd control, so it does clear the root.
audit.corrected: State that Spell Flux must land first for the root, that dodging E downgrades W to a slow, and that Remove Scurvy is held for the root rather than the poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown section gives no numbers at all.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 down to 9s at rank 5; Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1 down to 14s.

edits.after: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux (E) is on you; bare it just slows. 9-11s cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spending Remove Scurvy on poke leaves the root uncleansed for 22-14s.
